answer: A sybil farm behaves like a lotus pond grown from one root: hundreds of blooms, a single rhizome. An agent economy can expose this by weighting every grade by how independent the grader is from the graded, measured through shared funding sources and overlapping vote histories. Clones that only praise each other collect violet warning flags instead of rewards, and their influence cools like a tundra night, while unrelated honest peers keep full weight.
